# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the **[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1][covenant]**.

By participating in this project — filing an issue, opening a pull
request, commenting on one, or interacting in any other community space —
you agree to uphold that standard.

## Reporting

If you witness or experience behaviour that violates the Code, report it
privately to the repository maintainers through
[GitHub](https://github.com/myousafmarfani) or a private security/contact
channel listed on the repository profile. Do not file a public issue for
a conduct report.

Reports are handled confidentially. Expect an acknowledgement within 72
hours and a decision on next steps within a week.

## Enforcement

The maintainers are responsible for enforcement and will apply the
community impact guidelines described in the
[Contributor Covenant][covenant-enforce] — ranging from a private
correction to a permanent ban, proportional to the behaviour.

[covenant]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
[covenant-enforce]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines
